description: The archer at a distance that exceeds its own 12-unit range.
notes: The one deliberate exception to the shape series' fixed roster, and it is a different question: the archer's range is 12, larger than any previous arena's long half-axis, so until this room there was no position in the game outside its reach. At 26 units the gallery finally has one. Compare against `spacing_archer`, not against the series.
